interface.longDescription: Work through larger arithmetic. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Multiply by partial products; Follow long division; Scale equal fractions. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me multiply by partial products.

prompts: Help me multiply by partial products.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Number Steps: Grade 4 Math workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Multiply by partial products. Reproducible inputs: {"a":247,"b":36}
positive.prompt: Help me multiply by partial products with these supplied values: {"a":247,"b":36}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses grade_4_math_partial_products with the supplied inputs. Returns {"answer":8892,"partial_products":[{"place":"ones","value":1482},{"place":"tens","value":7410}],"equation":"247 × 36 = 8892"}. Shows the actual columns result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.prompt: Help me follow long division with these supplied values: {"dividend":873,"divisor":7}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses grade_4_math_long_division with the supplied inputs. Returns {"quotient":124,"remainder":5,"steps":[{"bring_down":8,"current":8,"quotient_digit":1,"subtract":7,"remainder":1},{"bring_down":7,"current":17,"quotient_digit":2,"subtract":14,"remainder":3},{"bring_down":3,"current":33,"quotient_digit":4,"subtract":28,"remainder":5}]}. Shows the actual columns result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.prompt: Help me scale equal fractions with these supplied values: {"numerator":3,"denominator":4,"factor":5}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses grade_4_math_equivalent_fraction with the supplied inputs. Returns {"original":"3/4","equivalent":"15/20","value":0.75,"reason":"Multiply both numerator and denominator by the same factor."}. Shows the actual fraction result. Does not fabricate external data.
